text:
```yaml
name: Build and Release Binaries

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Crystal
        run: |
          sh -ci "$(curl -fsSL https://crystal-lang.org/install.sh)"

      - name: Build binaries
        run: crystal build --release src/noir.cr -o bin/noir

      - name: Create release assets directory
        run: mkdir -p release-assets

      - name: Move binary to release assets directory
        run: mv bin/noir release-assets/noir-linux-x86_64

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          file: release-assets/noir-linux-x86_64
          asset_name: noir-linux-x86_64
```
